steps.title: Confirm scope, success criteria, constraints, and proof.
steps.evidence: Positive CLI fixtures use an explicitly injected in-process synthetic worker; the ordinary CLI separately proves unqualified execution is refused before a provider call. No CLI or environment bypass is added.

steps.title: Implement the smallest complete feature slice.
steps.evidence: Command construction accepts an optional trusted worker object. The ordinary CLI still constructs its real unqualified worker; no external qualification switch was added. Synthetic fixtures use only in-process fake collaborators.

steps.title: Add or update focused automated coverage.
